Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/controller/AuthController.java only.
IMPORTANT: Existing classes already exist and MUST be imported:
- import com.kaapstyle.auth.dto.RegisterRequest;
- import com.kaapstyle.auth.dto.LoginRequest;
- import com.kaapstyle.auth.dto.AuthResponse;
- import com.kaapstyle.auth.service.AuthService;

Requirements:
- @RestController, @RequestMapping('/api/auth'), @CrossOrigin
- Autowire AuthService via constructor injection.
- @PostMapping('/register'): accepts @Valid @RequestBody RegisterRequest req, returns ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(authService.register(req))
- @PostMapping('/login'): accepts @Valid @RequestBody LoginRequest req, returns ResponseEntity.ok(authService.login(req))
- Include @ExceptionHandler methods for:
  * IllegalArgumentException -> HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST
  * ResponseStatusException -> returns ex.getStatusCode() with error body
  * MethodArgumentNotValidException -> HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST with field error map
